name: x402engine
description: Pay-per-call API gateway for AI agents. 108 tools including image and video generation, LLM inference (72 models), code execution, audio transcription, voice cloning, crypto data, wallet analytics, travel, ENS, IPFS, web search, web scraping, and transaction simulation. All via HTTP 402 micropayments with USDC and USDm.

skills.name: Image Generation
skills.description: Generate images using AI (fast, quality, text-in-image, and Nano Banana 2 tiers). Prices: $0.015-$0.12 per image.
examples: Generate a photo of a sunset over mountains
Create a logo with the text 'Hello World'

skills.name: Video Generation
skills.description: Generate videos from text with Kling V3 Standard ($0.55), Kling V3 Pro ($0.70), or Hailuo 2.3 Pro ($0.65), and animate images with Kling V3 Pro ($0.70).
examples: Generate a video of a cat walking on a beach
Animate this image into a video

skills.name: LLM Inference
skills.description: Access 72 LLM models including GPT-5.6/5.4, Claude 5/4.8/4.6, Gemini 3.6/3.1, DeepSeek V4, Qwen 3.7, GLM 5.2, MiniMax M3, Kimi K3, Grok 4.5, and specialized coding and reasoning models. Prices: $0.002-$0.30 per request.
examples: Ask GPT-5 to summarize this document
Get Claude Opus to review this code

skills.name: Code Execution
skills.description: Execute code in a sandboxed environment. Supports Python, JavaScript, Bash, R, Ruby, Go, and Rust. Price: $0.005 per execution.
examples: Run this Python script
Execute a data analysis in R

skills.name: Audio Processing
skills.description: Transcribe audio to text (Deepgram Nova-3), generate speech from text (OpenAI, ElevenLabs), and clone voices with Lux TTS. Prices: $0.01-$0.10.
examples: Transcribe this audio file
Convert this text to speech

skills.name: Crypto Market Data

Show trending cryptocurrencies

Get transaction history for this wallet
